methodology: Three fresh temp directories per scenario; one logical-cold and five warm pages. OS caches are not flushed. Real durable writes precede timing; no Provider traffic. Memory differences are samples, not peak or a production p95. Repeated reads reverify disk chunk hashes; queue is Promise.all concurrency.
limitations: No production p95: 3 cold samples and 15 warm pages per scenario. OS page cache not flushed.
Memory deltas are sampled changes, not peak retained memory.
New pages verify only overlapping chunks; parent acceptance separately verifies the entire canonical body.
Legacy combined first page parses the whole file; warm file-URI pages re-read and verify only canonical and binding ranges. Non-file legacy layouts cannot use native ranges.
